headline: South Asia: Cairo vows support for Riyadh as 2 Saudi officers killed in helicopter crash near Yemen
script:
Good morning. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- South Asia: Cairo vows support for Riyadh as 2 Saudi officers killed in helicopter crash near Yemen.
- Western Russia: Russian airstrikes on Sloviansk kill six, injure 15, people trapped under rubble – photos.
- India: Iran Gets New Defence Minister 8 Months After Predecessor Killed In US Strikes.

Full breakdown follows.

NORTH AMERICA
United States - bottom line: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated.
- Military Times, 2 days ago: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated.
The Army's 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated as the service reshapes its PSYOP and information warfare forces to counter global adversaries.
Central America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.
The Caribbean: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

SOUTH AMERICA
South America: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

EUROPE
Western Russia - bottom line: Russian airstrikes on Sloviansk kill six, injure 15, people trapped under rubble – photos.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 5 hours ago: Russian airstrikes on Sloviansk kill six, injure 15, people trapped under rubble – photos.
Russian aerial bombs and drones killed six people and injured 15 in Sloviansk on 17 October, damaging over 20 houses; rescue workers are recovering bodies.
- Ukrainska Pravda, one hour ago: University teacher Kostiantyn Chub killed in Russian attack on Poltava.
Poltava Pedagogical University lecturer Kostiantyn Chub has been killed in a Russian drone attack that targeted residential areas in Poltava.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 2 hours ago: Warehouse catches fire in Lviv due to Russian drone attack.
A Russian drone attack has damaged a logistics complex and caused a warehouse fire in Malekhiv, while drone debris damaged homes in Murovane.
- Ukrainska Pravda, 5 hours ago: Ukraine prepares two low-cost domestic missiles for combat use against jet-powered Geran drones.
Andrii Hrytseniuk, head of Brave1, says two Ukrainian teams are preparing surface-to-air missiles costing under US$20,000 each for combat use against jet-powered drones.
Southern Europe - bottom line: France says Israel must ‘stop these acts of terror’ following attack on EU diplomats.
- Politico Europe, one hour ago: France says Israel must ‘stop these acts of terror’ following attack on EU diplomats.
Video footage of the incident in Taybeh, north of Jerusalem, showed settlers confronting a convoy of diplomats.

AFRICA
Africa - bottom line: Sudanese gold miners describe deadly airstrike that killed 72.
- Africanews, 6 hours ago: Sudanese gold miners describe deadly airstrike that killed 72.
Sudanese miners injured in a deadly airstrike along the border with Egypt last week have been describing how the incident unfolded.
- Africanews, 5 hours ago: Nigeria's Army Chief of Staff visits troops in Borno after deaths of 15 soliders.
The Nigerian Army Chief of Staff is visiting troops stationed in the northeast of the country, a few days after jihadists killed fifteen soldiers in the region.
- Africanews, 8 hours ago: DRC accuses ex-president Kabila of planning 'general attack' on the country.
Officials in DR Congo are accusing former president Joseph Kabila of planning a general attack on the country. Kabila on Monday joined forces with the rebel M23 to head a new outfit , taking a more direct role in the insurgency ravaging eastern DRC.
- Africanews, just now: Smashed storefronts, burned buildings: France wakes up to aftermath of violent protests.
France woke up Sunday to devastated streets after clashes between police and protesters, mass looting and fires erupted nationwide as marches against rising costs of living degenerated into "extreme" violence.
Persian Gulf Region - bottom line: Rubio says Ukraine without access to Starshield, future ‘under discussion’.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, 5 hours ago: Rubio says Ukraine without access to Starshield, future ‘under discussion’.
Top US diplomat says Ukraine has requested access to military-grade version of Starlink for strikes deep inside Russia.
- Jerusalem Post, 3 hours ago: 'You are the real target': Netanyahu warns Iran developing ICBMs, nuclear weapons to target US.
Netanyahu told FOX News that, if reelected prime minister, his key objectives would be to end the threat posed by Iran, expand the Abraham Accords, and seize the future of AI development.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, 5 hours ago: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as humanitarian crisis deepens.
Clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis cause casualties on both sides as aid agencies warn of humanitarian crisis.
- Al Jazeera - Middle East, one hour ago: Sudan army accused of drone strike on livestock market.
Sudan’s army says it struck RSF command centres in South Darfur, but the RSF says a crowded livestock market was hit.
South Africa: no notable developments in the last 48 hours.

ASIA
South Asia - bottom line: Cairo vows support for Riyadh as 2 Saudi officers killed in helicopter crash near Yemen.
- Dawn (Pakistan), South China Morning Post - China, The Hindu - International, one hour ago: Cairo vows support for Riyadh as 2 Saudi officers killed in helicopter crash near Yemen.
Egypt is ready to provide Saudi Arabia with the support it needs to defend its security and stability, the presidency said on Sunday. Earlier in the day, the Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis said two officers were killed when their helicopter crashed near the Yemen border, after the rebel group claimed it shot the aircraft down. The coalition blamed a “technical malfunction” for the helicopter crash, which inflicted its first military fatalities since the long-running conflict with the Houthis reignited in July.
- Dawn (Pakistan), Times of India - Top Stories, Al Jazeera - Middle East, one hour ago: Egypt ‘ready to defend’ Saudi Arabia against Houthis.
• President Sisi says Cairo will take ‘any measure’ to protect kingdom if asked • Iran backs ‘political process’, offers to mediate • Saudi, Houthi forces trade fire CAIRO: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi pledged on Saturday that Egypt was ready to help defend Saudi Arabia against attacks by Yemen’s Houthi forces if requested, as fighting intensified across the region and Cairo moved towards possible parliamentary authorisation for support.
- Dawn (Pakistan), one hour ago: 8 India-sponsored terrorists killed in Quetta, Khuzdar, Nushki districts: ISPR.
Security forces have killed eight “India-sponsored” terrorists during three intelligence-based operations conducted in the Quetta, Nushki and Khuzdar districts of Balochistan, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Sunday. The IBOs took place on Oct 17 (Saturday) on the “reported presence of terrorists belonging to Indian proxy Fitna al Hindustan”, the military’s media affairs wing said in its press release. The state has designated Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan.
- The Hindu - International, Ukrainska Pravda, 2 hours ago: Drone strikes in the Black Sea raise fears of Russian escalation to test NATO's response.
The attacks in the two countries' exclusive economic zones threaten a global shipping route and have left two people dead, with at least 25 still missing. They also run the risk of drawing other countries directly into the war for Ukraine

The attack comes amid deepening tensions between Ukraine and Washington, with U.S. President Donald Trump criticizing Kyiv for its strikes on Russian oil infrastructure.
- Times of India - Top Stories, one hour ago: Manipur in turmoil again: 15 houses torched; 1 killed, several injured in gun attack.
In Chassad village, located in Manipur's Kamjong district, at least 15 houses were burned late Saturday night. Suspected militants attacked the village, causing significant chaos and civilians to flee for safety. A Kuki civilian was killed during the assault, and four others suffered injuries from gunfire. Deputy Chief Minister Nemcha Kipgen condemned the violence and called for strict action against the perpetrators.
- NDTV - Top Stories, 4 hours ago: Iran's New Defence Minister's "Enormous Damage" Warning To US.
Iranian lawmakers had earlier approved Akhlaghi's appointment as the country's new defence minister, after his predecessor was killed on the first day of the war with the United States.

- South China Morning Post - China, 13 hours ago: US-Russia deal, Trump-Zelensky clash could leave Ukraine out in the cold.

US President Donald Trump, frustrated by high energy costs he blames partly on Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, has repeatedly criticised Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Palau authorities are investigating an alleged underwater attack by a South Korean divemaster on Taiwanese musician Devon Song and his Bangladeshi divemaster. Song, a member of the music group Nan Quan Mama, posted on social media that he and his divemaster, Sobuj Patwary, were attacked by a South Korean divemaster known as “Romeo”. - South China Morning Post - China, 13 hours ago: How land power could help US forces counter China in the Indo-Pacific.
Senior US commanders have highlighted the importance of land-based troops and equipment stationed in the Asia-Pacific in any conflict with China, countering assumptions that such a war would be fought mainly at sea and in the air. General Ron Clark, commander of US Army Pacific, said the “tyranny of distance” made it difficult to rely on air and naval forces during a panel discussion at the Association of the United States Army’s annual meeting this week. The comments reflect mounting concerns...
- South China Morning Post - China, 22 hours ago: Albanian police fire rubber bullets as student protesters call for PM to quit.
Police in Albania fired what appeared to be rubber bullets at protesters on Saturday, the fifth day of mass student protests demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama step down. Reuters video footage showed police firing a shotgun towards crowds outside the education ministry during clashes with protesters. Reuters reporters found rubber pellets on the ground and pellets hit two Reuters journalists ‌and several protesters, leaving round marks.
